vacancy_energetics.provenance: Li, Guo & Robertson, J. Phys. Chem. C 119 (2015), DOI 10.1021/acs.jpcc.5b02430. Absolute neutral V_O formation energies on rutile (110): sX 4.39 / 4.98 / 5.70 eV, GGA 3.71 / 4.10 / 4.79 eV (surface / first subsurface / bulk). Relative values are used; the oxygen chemical potential cancels in the canonical ensemble. Site energies are polaron-relaxed: Ti3+ small polarons are not explicit variables (context: Reticcioli et al., Phys. Rev. B 98 (2018) 045306).

surface_ordering.pair_table_note: Pair energies are calibrated, not computed: chosen so that spacings of 1-2 bridging sites are suppressed and the modal spacing near critical coverage is 4-5 sites, with the ordering energy scale of the published low-energy configurations (~0.2-0.3 eV). Replace with project DFT configuration energies when available.
surface_ordering.provenance: Birschitzky, Reticcioli et al., npj Comput. Mater. 10 (2024), DOI 10.1038/s41524-024-01289-4. DFT+U (U = 3.9 eV) + ML + Metropolis MC on rutile (110): computed critical coverage 16.7%, reconstruction threshold ~20%, interaction range ~10 A, in-row spacings of 1-2 sites nearly absent, most probable spacing 4-5 sites.

saturation.note: Beyond ~20% bridging-O vacancy coverage the (1x2) reconstruction takes over; the model pins surface content at the threshold instead of describing the reconstructed phase. x_max is the approximate rutile point-defect range before crystallographic shear planes.

diffusion_eV.note: Stored for a later kinetic version; not used by the equilibrium model. The surface-to-subsurface exchange barrier is a different path and is not any of these numbers.
diffusion_eV.provenance: Bulk: Iddir et al., J. Phys. Chem. C (2010), DOI 10.1021/jp107986a. Surface (unstrained rutile 110): Wang et al., Phys. Rev. B 82 (2010) 165309.
